Notes from the gardenSymbols, seed returns & how to play ＋

One line. Six little symbols.

Match any two to return your 10 seeds. Three of a kind returns the amount below. Three different symbols return 0. The spin cost is always 10.

A little world you can keep.

Start with 200 seeds. When fewer than 10 remain, gather 100 more for free. Every spin grows the garden, including spins that return no seeds.

Three golden seeds unlock Kin early: a 1 in 8,000 chance per spin. Kin also arrives at 60 turns. This is the same golden koi you can feed, name, and grow in Stillwater Pond.

Use the Spin button with a mouse, touch, Enter, or Space. Sound starts only when enabled. Turn motion off for a quiet, immediate reveal.

Your progress stays in this browser. If your pond is full, make room for Kin there, then return to invite them.
